releaseNotes: Identical teacher posts within two minutes appear as one card with the number of combined posts. Dashboard counts reflect the combined cards.
Combining requires matching teacher, subject, full message, links and verified attachment contents. Changed or unavailable attachments keep posts separate.
Original records remain saved. Existing Reviewed flags are preserved, and Review or Undo applies to every copy in a combined card.
Comparison uses local files with cached content hashes and adds no LMS requests. Credentials, schedules, history and assignment status are preserved; school access remains read-only.
